days.file: Rembrandt Harmensz. van Rijn - Jeremia treurend over de verwoesting van Jeruzalem - Google Art Project.jpg
days.title: Jeremiah Lamenting the Destruction of Jerusalem
days.alt: The prophet Jeremiah, grey-bearded and in a dark robe, rests his head on his hand beside a large book.
days.look: Look again at Jeremiah, his head resting on his hand. What would it mean to trust God with the road you cannot yet see?
days.license: Artist died 1669; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: Marten de Vos - The Last Supper - Google Art Project.jpg
days.title: The Last Supper
days.alt: Christ sits at the centre of a long table with the twelve apostles leaning toward him, all of them listening.
days.look: Look again at the apostles leaning in toward Jesus. What would you ask Him to teach you?
days.license: Artist died 1603; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: John Henry Newman by Sir John Everett Millais, 1st Bt.jpg
days.title: Cardinal John Henry Newman
days.alt: Cardinal Newman in red cardinal's robes, thin and white-haired, gazes calmly off to one side.
days.look: Look again at Newman's quiet, steady face. What work might God have prepared for you?
days.license: Artist died 1896; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: Willem de Poorter's The Parable of The Talents or Minas.png
days.title: The Parable of the Talents
days.alt: In a bright stone hall a servant bends over a table to give an account to his master, while others stand and watch.
days.look: Look again at the servant giving his account at the table. What has God already put into your hands?
days.license: Artist died 1668; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.title: The Pentecost
days.alt: Tongues of fire hover above the apostles who gather around Mary, their faces and hands raised, while a white dove glows above them.
days.look: Look again at the flames above their heads. Where have you felt even a little peace?
days.license: Artist died 1614; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.title: Jethro and Moses
days.alt: Inside a tent, a man in a white headcloth speaks to a circle of elders who sit close around him on a carpet, listening.
days.look: Look again at the elders gathered close in the tent. Who could you sit down with and listen to this week?
days.license: Artist died 1902; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: Rembrandt - The Parable of the Rich Fool.jpg
days.title: The Parable of the Rich Fool
days.alt: By candlelight an old man in a fur-trimmed cap holds a coin up to the flame, surrounded by ledgers and money bags.
days.look: Look again at the coin held up to the candle. What do you want to be able to say your life was for?
days.license: Artist died 1669; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: James Jacques Joseph Tissot - The Ark Passes Over the Jordan - Google Art Project.jpg
days.title: The Ark Passes Over the Jordan
days.alt: Four priests in white robes carry the golden Ark of the Covenant on poles along the riverbed, with a great wall of water standing behind them.
days.look: Look again at the priests standing firm with the Ark between the walls of water. What step is waiting for you to take it?
days.license: Artist died 1902; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.title: The Annunciation
days.alt: Mary in a blue mantle raises one hand and bows her head as the kneeling angel Gabriel points upward, a white lily in his arms.
days.look: Look again at Mary’s raised hand as she bows her head. What would you like to give over to God today?
days.license: Artist died 1639; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)
